text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I dropped by a family restaurant, Agnes Digital was there working on something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was working with an unusually serious look on her face. Could she be trying out something new again?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ――Gah!? Awa-wa-wa!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ............Did you see?
choice_data_list: A laptop? I thought I saw some illustration on it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that I was trying to peek, so I just told her what caught the corner of my eye.
Was that something she drew herself?
choice_data_list: It's admirable how you're always trying new things!
It's admirable how you're always trying new things!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I once again expressed the admiration I had felt before.
When working, it's often difficult to find new interests and act on them so freely.
choice_data_list: I really respect how proactive you are!
I really respect how proactive you are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ............No, no, no, respect?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You've got it wrong!
My 'experiences' are more like playing pretend, it's not something praiseworthy at all!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm just imitating what my beloved horse girls do, so as an action, it's honestly kinda bordering on rude――
choice_data_list: Trying to imitate them isn't a bad thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well, that may be true, but still!! Making a book out of it is a whole different story, or rather――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaaah...! Digi-tan, why do you always blab things you shouldn't say...?!
choice_data_list: So that means you were making a book just now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ugh, there's no escaping this atmosphere anymore... That's right... It's what you'd call creative doujin work.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whatever my oshi does, I want to imitate it. I want to empathize with how my oshi feels...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And I want to share that preciousness with my fellow comrades!! Otherwise――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My feelings will overflow and explode!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Of course, I have no intention of claiming that just dabbling in something lets me truly understand my oshi's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even so, every time I retrace what my oshi does, I feel like I can touch a fraction of their hard work, their fun, and their joy――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The sheer preciousness... makes my heart feel like it's bursting! When that happens, I just can't sit still without creating something!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's why I create doujinshi!
To shape that profound emotional impact into a tangible form, and share its divine preciousness with fellow fans!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because the sheer brilliance of my beloved oshi is far too blinding to keep bottled up all alone!!
choice_data_list: (To put so much passion into making books...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her overwhelming fervor caught me off guard at first, but the more I listened, the harder it was to see her activities as anything negative.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In fact, as a Trainer, I couldn't help but feel a deep sense of respect for the sheer amount of love she directed toward horse girls—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: .........T-Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...
Hearing you say that completely blows away how embarrassed I was earlier... Wait, hold on—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what, hold up! Did my oshi just update her UmaSta!?
N-No way, and is this—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
SHE TOOK UP A NEW HOBBY~~~?!!!
And she deliberately picked something off the beaten path too?! Ahhh, that's so her~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I MUST include this in my next release!
Ah, but if I have to start picking it up right now, time is gonna be—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, absolutely not!!
Now that I know, I have to experience it for myself!!
That is my solemn duty as someone who stans horse girls!!
choice_data_list: ...Is there anything I can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Agnes Digital regain all her boundless momentum in a flash, I asked with a fond smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
FOR REAL!?!?
Actually, this sport is played in pairs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I was worried I wouldn't grasp the proper feel all by myself...
This helps me out a TON~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll hunt down a trial class at lightning speed!
I'm counting on you to come with me!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: YES!! I shall bask in the divine aura of my oshi with every ounce of my being~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of us embarked on a whole new 'experience'!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ......Then, please just cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I must now enter Asura Crunch Mode...
First, I'll finish my current draft with everything I've got to meet the deadline—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After that, I'll find a trial workshop and whip up a bonus copybook! That's how victory is seized!!
choice_data_list: Hang in there, I know you can do it!!
Hang in there, I know you can do it!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
ALRIGHTTT~~~!!!! I'LL DO THIS!!
Now is the time! Time to showcase the true otaku way of life~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after that, I frequently spotted Agnes Digital glued to her computer, typing away with demon-like intensity.
